# Board protocol messages (generated by scripts/gen-proto.sh) and the vendored
# nanopb runtime, plus record size helpers. No dynamic allocation:
# PB_ENABLE_MALLOC is not defined.

    SRCS "ns_board.pb.c"
         "ns_proto_fit.c"
         "nanopb/pb_common.c"
         "nanopb/pb_encode.c"
         "nanopb/pb_decode.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "." "nanopb"
)
